title: Refactor Net Extension Functions Into Classes
description: Refactor all extension functions in compose/net into their respective classes as static pure methods. Remove `this` from Utility.Serialize and Utility.Deserialize extension methods. Convert Entity<T>.DeepClone() and Validate() to static methods. Move all ComposeExt functions into their relevant domain classes (Design, Kit, Tag, Concept, Model, Connector, Piece, Connection). Convert all instance methods on Design, Kit, and other entity classes to static methods with the instance as first parameter. Make Flatten and Sort pure (no mutation, return new Design). Update all callers in Tests.cs, Program.cs (Benchmark), and Compose.Grasshopper.cs. Delete ComposeExt.cs after merging. Work purely functional with class style on pure return.
summary: Refactored all extension functions in compose/net into their respective classes as static pure methods. Removed extension methods from ComposeExt.cs (now deleted). Converted Utility.Serialize/Deserialize to static, Entity.DeepClone/Validate to static. Moved FlattenDesign and ReplaceClusterWithDesign from ComposeExt into Kit class. Added static Find/FindIn/FindFor helpers to Tag, Concept, Model, Connector, Piece, Connection, Kit. Fixed ZipRoundtrip/KitImporter to load .compose/kit.db from zip. Fixed SQLite loading: rowid ordering, NULL boolean handling (IsAbstract false→null), tag ordering via JOIN. Changed TypeDiff/ConnectorDiff/DesignDiff.Attributes from List<Attribute> to AttributesDiff to match JSON schema. Added AttributesDiff.Apply static helper. Fixed Benchmark ExportKit call signature. All 10 tests pass.
